step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified system entry point: 'Device / Digital Human Interface' representing web-capable user devices (mobile/laptop). The generic human 'USER' actor is pruned per Node Rule 5.
2. Identified primary orchestration and third-party rendering nodes: 'LAMBDA BOT' (AWS Lambda) which coordinates intent routing, and 'UNEEQ' (ThirdParty) which hosts the digital human avatar.
3. Identified speech and NLP processing nodes: 'LEX' (Amazon Lex) for speech-to-text recognition and intent understanding, and 'POLLY' (Amazon Polly) for text-to-speech avatar vocalization.
4. Identified knowledge lookup services: 'OPENSEARCH' (Amazon OpenSearch) for rapid sub-second query resolution (90-95% of queries), and 'LAMBDA' (AWS Lambda) triggering 'KENDRA' (Amazon Kendra) for deeper FAQ/knowledge base lookups.
5. Identified fallback contact center node: 'CONNECT' (Amazon Connect) for routing unresolved queries (~5-10%) to live agents with full conversation context.
6. Mapped edges chronologically into 4 distinct workflows: Flow 0 for primary digital human interactive chat loop, Flow 1 for fast OpenSearch query retrieval, Flow 2 for detailed Kendra knowledge retrieval, and Flow 3 for Amazon Connect agent escalation.

graph.name: Digital Human Customer Service Architecture with UNEEQ, Lex, OpenSearch, Kendra, and Connect
graph.notes: Consigna's Anteso digital human architecture utilizes UNEEQ for animated avatar generation, Amazon Lex/Polly for natural speech processing, OpenSearch for sub-second rapid responses (90-95% query resolution), Kendra for deep knowledge base searching, and Amazon Connect for seamless agent escalation.

nodes.name: Device / Digital Human Interface

nodes.name: LAMBDA BOT
nodes.notes: Central orchestration bot powered by AWS Lambda handling incoming user requests and interaction state.

nodes.name: UNEEQ
nodes.notes: Third-party digital human service delivering the animated avatar presentation.

nodes.name: OPENSEARCH
nodes.notes: Amazon OpenSearch cluster providing sub-second search responses for standard user queries.

nodes.name: LAMBDA

nodes.name: KENDRA
nodes.notes: Amazon Kendra intelligent search service indexing existing customer FAQ knowledge base articles.

nodes.name: CONNECT
nodes.notes: Amazon Connect contact center platform managing agent call-backs for 5-10% fallback queries.

edges.notes: User transmits interaction input via client device to Lambda Bot.
Lambda Bot forwards speech/text input to Amazon Lex for recognition.
Lex passes parsed intent and speech state back to UNEEQ avatar interface.
Amazon Polly delivers synthesized audio streams to UNEEQ for speech rendering.
Lambda Bot synchronizes session state and avatar animation controls with UNEEQ.
Lex queries OpenSearch for sub-second rapid answer retrieval (handles 90-95% of queries).
Lex invokes Lambda for complex or detailed knowledge lookups.
Lambda queries Amazon Kendra to extract answers from indexed FAQ knowledge base documents.
Lambda Bot routes unresolvable interactions (remaining 5-10%) to Amazon Connect contact center agents.
